tasks.title: Next year
tasks.starter:
name = input()
age = input()
print("Hello " + name + ", next year you will be", age + 1)

tests.output: Hello Sam, next year you will be 13
Hello Ava, next year you will be 14

hints.error: age holds text, so age + 1 can't work. Cast it with int() when you read it.
hints.spaces: The comma before age + 1 adds one space. Check the spaces inside your speech marks.

hints.other: If you got 1212, the number is still text. Use int(input()).
